scope: C-end discrimination plus learner-only utterance-length and task-mode readiness gates layered on top of the frozen v5 scientific promotion protocol

decision_semantics.pass: v5 scientific gates and v10 C-end learner-discrimination/length/task gates pass; candidate may enter a separate score-changing A/B branch with a new ScoreContract
decision_semantics.fail: candidate must remain shadow; do not rescue by tuning on held data
decision_semantics.insufficient: collect more held learner/native/short/long/task criterion data before any score-changing branch

rationale.learner_only: overall native-plus-learner correlation can look good even when learner scores collapse into a narrow band
rationale.length_coverage: short/long robustness must be demonstrated inside learner speech rather than be rescued by native controls
rationale.task_coverage: a free-speaking consumer score must remain directionally useful for both spontaneous answers and controlled-dialogue responses inside the learner population
rationale.group_direction: native controls are a construct-contamination safety check, not a native-likeness target; when human group differences are meaningful the machine must follow their direction, and when human groups are similar the machine must not invent a large native/learner score gap
rationale.no_new_score_mapping: these gates validate candidate behavior only; they do not alter ProductScore or fit a new mapping
